defects.description: The term 'value' (and 'defaults') is mistranslated as 'замечание' (remark/note) instead of 'значение'.
The term 'value' (and 'defaults') is mistranslated as 'замечание' (remark/note) instead of 'значение'.
The term 'reviews' in a technical context (evaluating a task) is mistranslated as 'отзывы' (customer feedback/reviews). Additionally, the hyphen in 'аналитической-задаче' is grammatically incorrect.
